name: jig-review
description: Configurable parallel reviews and review-fix loops that diagnose stalls and route recovery using Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor/Grok.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-model reviews and fix loops with recovery
interface.longDescription: Skills for selecting isolated Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor Agent with Grok 4.6 reviewers, running them in parallel over the same scope, and deduplicating their findings. Includes a persisted review-fix controller with task contracts, balanced causal repairs by default, minimal and comprehensive investigation modes, diagnosed recovery and explicit budgets, validation, recoverable file application, and fresh reviews over working-tree or branch scopes. Panel review defaults to Claude plus Codex; the review-fix loop defaults to the host's own provider: native Codex in Codex, independent Claude reviews in Claude Code.
defaultPrompt: Use $jig-review:panel-review to review my changes with Claude and Codex
